purpose: Bounded expanded-synthetic training and paired mask-supervision diagnostic before adaptive control; no real-data fit or physical acceptance
initialization: Each candidate starts from the same pinned COCO weights; neither resumes the pilot or another candidate
interpretation: Expanded-data fits use more image passes and optimization updates than the original pilot; the comparison does not isolate data quantity from compute.
The two new fits share data, initialization and schedule; their paired representation change combines mask ratio and overlap behavior rather than isolating each independently.

Best checkpoints are selected by each trainer on the same development images. Native standalone scoring uses common polygon masks; trainer mAP values have different mask representations and are not the common comparison.

required: Seed overlap including misses as zero, valid coverage and area bias/MAE
Temporal event/negative/deadline results by source split
Native current-area error and frozen old forecast comparison on validation clips

temporal.rule: Write a new source-bound replay experiment after fitting each candidate; original frozen experiment is not modified
temporal.note: Old forecast parameters are deliberately not recalibrated to new observation masks. Training and validation clips remain distinct.

selection: Retain both candidate fits and report all failures. Real review, budgets and independent KDP evidence remain separate gates.
